title: Trader Diary: BTC rockets to $81k 🚀
content:
Price hits $81,208 (+4.2%).
I slap a 10x long, hear the margin alarm scream.
3 AM me: “Just one more candle…”
Result: My wallet does a disappearing act.
lesson: If you’re using 10x, treat it like a hot potato—don’t hold it too long.
question: Who else turned a coffee break into a cardio session today? Be real 👇
